identity.title: [v0.91.8][podcast][ui] Update podcast studio copy from integrated design

values.task_boundary: Apply the operator-requested studio copy/logo/layout fixes without redesigning the page or modifying podcast generator behavior.
deliverables: copied Agent Logic logo asset in the studio bundle
focused validation evidence for studio route, digest, audio, and RSS
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The studio page uses the Agent Logic logo asset rather than the placeholder/export logo.
AC-2: The visible show name is Synthetic Minds Podcast.
AC-3: The hero copy says 'Special guests join us occasionally.'
AC-4: Episodes are proposed launch topics numbered from 1, with fake historical numbers removed.
AC-5: The gap below the Listen now button is reduced without disrupting the design.
AC-6: The contact link uses podcast@agent-logic.ai.
AC-7: The FAQ answer says there is no video.
AC-9: The footer puts the copyright line and disclaimer on separate lines.
AC-10: Existing studio assets load, and audio/RSS validation still passes.
non_goals: redesigning the studio page beyond the requested copy/logo/spacing fixes
claiming that proposed episode topics are recorded episodes
